# Names after "mutant" in a test comment that are no ledger row
# (TestTestCommentsNameLedgerRows; batch 18 verify M4). A row is `path<TAB>name`.

# so the list only shrinks: repair a stale name by naming the ledger row,
# adding the row, or dropping the claim, then remove its row here.
